card.name: Linking words in geology passages
card.fires_on: Commas, small linking words (by, of, into, in, under) and periods in technical passages about rock deformation and metamorphism. Mostly where a depth, condition or material term is expected next.

modes.description: A comma or period after a rock-type or depth phrase in a description of deformation zones.
